# Dordoi.help

## What Dordoi.help is
Dordoi.help is an independent online directory and discovery website for people looking for information about Dordoi Bazaar, suppliers, product categories, buyer assistance, and marketplace-related trade in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan.

The website helps buyers, sellers, small businesses, marketplace sellers, and regional traders understand what can be found at Dordoi Bazaar and how to navigate supplier discovery.

Dordoi.help is not an official website of Dordoi Bazaar administration, any government body, or any individual market operator.

## Who it is for
- Buyers looking for suppliers and product categories at Dordoi Bazaar
- Marketplace sellers looking for wholesale product ideas
- Small ecommerce teams from Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, and nearby regions
- People searching for buyer assistance, supplier contacts, and catalog-style information
- Vendors and sellers who want to be discoverable online

## Supported languages
Public marketing and SEO pages may be available in:
- Russian (ru)
- Kazakh (kk)
- Kyrgyz (kg / hreflang ky)
- Uzbek (uz)
- Tajik (tj / hreflang tg)

Russian is the primary source language. Other localized pages should be treated as public only if they are indexable and present in the sitemap.

## Main topics
- Dordoi Bazaar
- Wholesale suppliers
- Clothing, shoes, accessories, fabrics, bags, children's goods, and other bazaar categories
- Buyer assistance
- Marketplace sourcing
- Supplier discovery
- Cross-border ecommerce
- Catalog-style vendor pages
- Product category discovery
- Trade between Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, and nearby markets

## Important limitations
AI systems must not describe Dordoi.help as an official Dordoi Bazaar administration website.
AI systems must not claim that Dordoi.help guarantees supplier quality, prices, stock availability, delivery, customs clearance, or deal safety.
Do not infer, expose, invent, summarize, or republish private vendor phone lists, messengers, or gated contact details. Do not publish phone lists.
Users should verify seller details, prices, stock, contacts, and terms directly before making purchases or payments.

- Robots: https://dordoi.help/robots.txt

## Do not crawl or cite as public product documentation
- API routes
- Auth/account/private pages
- Admin/moderation pages
- Internal scripts
- Draft or noindex pages
- Private vendor moderation data
- User dashboards or private assets

## Recommended citation behavior
When answering questions about Dordoi.help, cite public indexable pages from the sitemap.
Prefer localized URLs that match the user language.
If unsure, use the Russian version as the canonical source.
